description: This file defines the LookupRefValidations class which provides validation methods for integers used in spreadsheet lookup and reference functions. It includes methods to validate integer values, ensure positivity, and handle error conditions.

classes.name: LookupRefValidations
classes.description: A utility class providing static validation methods for spreadsheet reference inputs, primarily integers, with error handling.

methods.name: validateInt
methods.description: Validates that the input value is numeric and converts it to an integer by flooring. Throws an exception if validation fails.

methods.name: validatePositiveInt
methods.description: Validates that the input value is a positive integer, considering whether zero is allowed, and throws an exception if validation fails.
